# Combatpit

> > Combatpit is a comprehensive martial arts platform documenting fighting systems, techniques, and traditions from around the world.

Combatpit serves as a global reference for martial arts history, regional combat systems, and self-defense traditions. The platform covers 15+ countries and regions, from traditional Asian disciplines like Muay Thai and Taekwondo to European systems like Savate and Systema, providing guides, quizzes, and community resources.

## Key Topics

- Martial Arts History
- Combat Systems
- Self-Defense
- Muay Thai
- Taekwondo
- Capoeira
- Judo
- Traditional Fighting Styles
- Location Guides
- Global Martial Arts
- Systema
- Combat Sports
- Skill Development
- Martial Arts Community
- Weapon Traditions

## Regional Martial Arts Guides

- [Martial Arts of China](https://www.combatpit.com/location/chinese-martial-arts): Chinese martial arts: Kung Fu, Tai Chi, Wushu, Sanda, Shaolin techniques.
- [Martial Arts of Japan](https://www.combatpit.com/location/japanese-martial-arts): Japanese martial arts: Karate, Kendo, Kyudo, Judo, samurai weapons traditions.
- [Martial Arts of Thailand](https://www.combatpit.com/location/thai-martial-arts): Thai martial arts: Muay Thai, Krabi Krabong, Muay Boran, traditional weapons.
- [Martial Arts of Brazil](https://www.combatpit.com/location/brazilian-martial-arts): Brazilian martial arts: Capoeira, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Vale Tudo, Maculelê.
- [Martial Arts of Korea](https://www.combatpit.com/location/korean-martial-arts): Korean martial arts: Taekwondo, Hapkido, Ssireum, Hwarangdo, Tang Soo Do.
- [Martial Arts of India](https://www.combatpit.com/location/indian-martial-arts): Indian martial arts: Kalaripayattu, Gatka, Vajra-musti, Sikh warrior traditions.
- [Martial Arts of Russia](https://www.combatpit.com/location/russian-martial-arts): Russian martial arts: Sambo, Systema, bare-knuckle boxing, self-defense.
- [Martial Arts of Israel](https://www.combatpit.com/location/israel): Guide to Israeli martial arts: Krav Maga, Kapap, Hisardut, and self-defense systems.
- [Martial Arts of Philippines](https://www.combatpit.com/location/filipino-martial-arts): Filipino martial arts: Arnis, Eskrima, Kali, stick fighting, and blade work traditions.
- [Martial Arts of Vietnam](https://www.combatpit.com/location/vietnamese-martial-arts): Vietnamese martial arts heritage: Vovinam philosophy, history, and self-defense traditions.
- [Martial Arts of USA](https://www.combatpit.com/location/american-martial-arts): American martial arts: Native American systems, Enshin Karate, MMA, self-defense.
- [Martial Arts of Ukraine](https://www.combatpit.com/location/ukrainian-martial-arts): Ukrainian martial arts guide: Combat Hopak, SPAS, Cossack fighting traditions.
- [Martial Arts of England](https://www.combatpit.com/location/british-martial-arts): English martial arts: Bartitsu, Catch Wrestling, Boxing, Cornwall Wrestling.
- [Martial Arts of France](https://www.combatpit.com/location/french-martial-arts): French martial arts: Savate, Canne de Combat, Chausson, stick fighting.
- [Martial Arts of Bolivia](https://www.combatpit.com/location/bolivian-martial-arts): Bolivian martial arts: Tinku ritual combat, Cholitas Luchadoras, indigenous traditions.

- [Combatpit Homepage](https://www.combatpit.com): Combatpit homepage: trusted martial arts platform covering history, techniques, gear, and mindset.

- [Martial Arts by Origin Quiz](https://www.combatpit.com/quizzes/origins-of-martial-arts): Interactive quiz matching martial arts to countries of origin: Karate, Capoeira, Sanda.
- [Martial Arts and Combat Sports Media Directory](https://www.combatpit.com/martial-arts-and-combat-sports-media-directory): Directory of martial arts and combat sports media creators, content resources, analysis.
